My two cents in the @Starknet proposal is that companies and ecosystems should always pursue product market fit beyond all else. 

If becoming an L1 helps them with PMF, then they should race ahead and go for it. 

Staying, or becoming an L2, shouldn’t rely upon cult alignment. It should simply be the best business decision from features, operational costs, access to liquidity etc. 

Answering those questions will depend on the teams business objectives and technical capabilities. 

Many teams will benefit from becoming L2s, others who are willing to have higher operational costs and are technically capable, may simply want to go the L1 route. 

I hope they do what is best for themselves and their users.
